svg.title: Payer access through the source object — evaluated alternative, not selected
svg.desc: Evaluated and not selected alternative kept for the record: payer users read the resource-owned order or subscription directly under a payer predicate. The selected design uses tenant-owned derived views validated freshly against consent, grant and assignment facts; see the commercial DESIGN. No implementation implied.
svg.text: Payer access through a confirmed assignment
EVALUATED ALTERNATIVE · NOT SELECTED · Payer reads the resource-owned source object
1 BSS establishes facts — eligibility alone grants no read access
Projection contract still to be designed
Role grants this action in Holding
Enforce together, on the same leg:
ACME is not a blanket grant
No row returned through this path.
Current-access flow only. Historical financial access is separate. Freshness and cross-tenant policy require platform agreement.
